spiritgiven.comments: Thanks for the great start to the tournament!! We really enjoyed this game!!
It was a fun and well spirited game!
Both teams will work on using hand signals!

Thank you for talking things out with us! We would also like to give some feedback about your sideline - sideline tends to get frustrated and make comments about the call on the field, letting the players talk it out and echoing the hand signs if a foul/call has occurred would be good. Take note about the pulls as well, if no hand was raised on our end, defence can only pull on the third whistle. Other than that, great game!

Great game overall! WE LOVE YOUR COACH!!! big hearts for him 

We would like for both teams to use more hand signals on a stoppage and indicate early and wait for the appropriate time to call a secondary call (eg picks and injuries). We hope that your players will not be shy to speak up about any level of contact that is not acceptable to them :)

There was a lot of foul calls on us where your players called the foul on us for the contact initiated by your players. Your players need to chat with us to agree on the level of physicality after each point. 

Fair mindedness: Based on the SOTG rubric scoring, your team only took the stance that you were correct on calls, with your teammates only giving opinions where your result was favourable for your team.
Great game! You all were so well spirited!
Thank you for a great team!
Great game! Thank you for adjusting your spirit:)

spiritreceived.comments: Helped us make calls when we didn’t have perspective
There were many picks during the game, so that’s something to watch out for in the future!
A few negative comments on the sidelines during injury subs, disbelieving our validity of injury calls.

They are not looking at disc and defencing, so always blocking the way and pushing us. 
But it was great game thank you.
Had a great game with all calls settled on the field and good discussions between players, thank you!
